_readme: Every line Panda says in the two rooms: the bedroom (/room.html) and the living room (Home, /living-room.html).
Edit freely; the pages read this file on load (no build step). Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored.
Keep each line <= 48 characters (one dialog-box line; longer ones log a warning in the browser console).
Use straight quotes: the PC-98 font draws curly ones full-width.
Doors (door_bedroom, door_outside) only have hover lines: clicking a door goes straight through it.
greeting: the opening box. hover: the line on pointing at an object. click: the box on first opening it this visit;
repeat: on opening it again. lines (on an object): what a no-link object says. choices: the menu after click
(label, and href or copy). lines (on a room): idle (after a while with no input), empty (clicking nothing), replies.
Living room only, for live state (the house's real devices): a variant per state, chosen by the page:
lamps: hover_on / hover_off / hover_unknown (feed down); lines, or lines_on / lines_off. {brightness} (percent),
{kelvin}, {warmth} (warm / soft white / daylight) fill in when the lamp is on.
tv: hover_off / hover_on (an idle screen) / hover_playing / hover_unknown; lines, lines_playing.
speakers: hover_playing / hover_quiet / hover_unknown; lines, lines_playing.
kotatsu: hover_on / hover_off / hover_unknown (its plug); lines, lines_on.
thermostat: hover and lines may use {temp} (F), {heat} (on/off), {humidity}; hover_unknown when there's no reading.
blinds: hover_open / hover_partial / hover_closed / hover_unknown; {pct} (percent open) in hover_partial.
Bedroom lines are adapted visual-novel lines; their sources: pc98-assets/assets/panda-room/dialogue-sources.md.

greeting: Welcome, traveler, to my room of mysteries.
Don't be shy now, come on in.
Poke around all you like! Lost? Press LOOK.

window.name: Window
window.hover: E-everything looks so p-pretty at night...
click: The town, the people... we're all family.
I tweet about it way too much. Mostly zoning.

phone.name: Phone
phone.hover: Eh? My phone's buzzing... is that you?
click: On Discord, you can call me vivalapanda.
Secrets go on Signal. They're safe with me.
repeat: If friends gossip about us... how embarrassing.

pc.name: PC
pc.hover: I keep falling asleep at that computer...
click: My true love has always been my computer.
Everything I make ends up on GitHub.
repeat: Back again? It's an infinitely repeating game.

newspaper.name: Newspaper
newspaper.hover: Heh. Who knew my essays could be interesting?
click: I write about cities on my Substack.
Well, you can read it at your own pace.
repeat: Are you ready to continue reading?

bookshelf.name: Bookshelf
bookshelf._note: The one on-site link in the room: Panda chose the bookshelf over a sidebar icon (2026-10-07).
bookshelf.hover: If it's books you want, leave it to me.
click: You could say I really enjoy reading...
I barely got to do any reading today, so...
repeat: Coffee can be nice with books too, you know?

butterfly.name: Butterfly
butterfly.hover: I love butterflies. They are the best animal.
click: That one's my Bluesky. I'm there sometimes.
It wouldn't be so bad to be the sky.
repeat: Why would it be a bird? It's a butterfly!

tv.name: TV
click: Every movie I watch goes on my Letterboxd.
Let's go watch!

letter.name: Letter
letter.hover: I wrote to my parents last week.
click: You can write to me too! I'm at me@panda.moe.
Everything that you write is a treasure to me.
repeat: Write to me, okay? I'll write back.

controller.name: Game console
controller._note: Verified 2026-10-04: profile VivaLaPanda, summary "I play games rarely."
controller.hover: Eh? Just playing some Cities: Skylines.
click: I play games rarely. ...Very rarely.
Hey, what's your favorite game?

lesswrong.name: Tome
lesswrong.hover: Ah, now I started thinking again. This is bad.
click: My nerdier essays go up on LessWrong.
I could go on, but I think you get the point...
repeat: As rational as ever, I see.

linkedin.name: Blazer
linkedin.hover: Is it hard, being an adult?
click: I wear it to interviews. And on LinkedIn.
Need me for work stuff? LinkedIn's the place.
repeat: Thank you for your hard work today.

kitsu.name: Anime tapes
kitsu._note: Verified 2026-10-06: last list update 2022-07-10, 544 entries, ~93 days of anime. More current than MAL (last update 2018).
kitsu.hover: Gaze upon my anime tapes and despair!
click: Kitsu says I've watched 93 days of anime.
...And I stopped logging in 2022. Oops.
repeat: Holy moly! Anime is so extreme these days

stackoverflow.name: Rubber duck
stackoverflow.hover: You think rubber ducks are creepy?
click: I asked the duck for an answer. It was no use.
So I took my question to Stack Overflow.
repeat: That's a good question. ...Closed as duplicate.

bump.name: City map
bump.hover: I'm not lost. I just don't know where I am.
click: On Bump, my friends are pins on a map.
I can tell where you went without a GPS.
repeat: I've got to go meet up with a friend of mine.

plush.name: Panda plush
lines: He's the original Panda. I'm the sequel.
Sorry, I was born cute.

poster.name: Poster
poster.hover: Cuteness wins in the end. Cuteness is justice!
lines: That's my favorite magical girl!
Abracadabra! Welcome to life as a magical girl!

desk_lamp.name: Desk lamp
lines: It's my real bedroom lamp, mirrored.
When I switch it at home, it switches here.
lines_on: It's on in my real room right now.

idle: It's nice and quiet in here, isn't it?
Do... would you like some tea?
Luck comes to those who smile. So, smile!
Hear that? The last train's heading home.
empty: Hm? Are you talking to moi?
If you need something, just say it!
lines.lookPrompt: What do you want to look at?
lines.leaving: It's not good bye, it's see you again.
lines.copyFailed: Huh? It didn't copy... it's vivalapanda!

greeting: Welcome home! This is my living room.
It's my real house, live. Lights and all!
The doors lead on. Have a look around!

door_bedroom.name: Bedroom door
door_bedroom.hover: My room's through there. All my stuff's in it.

door_outside.name: Front door
door_outside.hover: The city's right out there. Get some air?

tv.name: TV
tv.hover_on: The TV's on, but nothing's playing.
tv.hover_playing: Something's playing on the TV right now!
tv.hover_unknown: The TV. On? Off? Can't tell.
lines: It's my real TV, mirrored here.
When I cast something, it plays here too.

kotatsu.name: Kotatsu
kotatsu.hover_on: The kotatsu's on. Get under the blanket!
kotatsu.hover_unknown: My kotatsu. Best seat in the house.
lines: A kotatsu: a table with a heater under it.
Once you're under, you can't leave.
lines_on: It's warm under there right now.
Once you're under, you can't leave.

lamp_sun.name: The Sun
lines: It's a Brighter lamp. I call it The Sun.
It helps a lot on gray mornings.

lamp_dining.name: Arc lamp
lamp_dining.hover_unknown: The arc lamp over the couch.
lines: It hangs right over the couch.
Perfect for reading.

lamp_corner.name: Corner lamp
lines: A little lamp in the TV corner.

lamp_window.name: Windowside lamp
lines: It sits by the window. Very cozy at night.

speaker_l.name: Speaker (left)
speaker_l.hover_playing: Music's playing in my house right now!
speaker_l.hover_quiet: The speakers are quiet right now.
lines: They're real. When I play music, it shows.

speaker_r.name: Speaker (right)
speaker_r.hover_playing: Music's playing in my house right now!
speaker_r.hover_quiet: The speakers are quiet right now.
lines: They're real. When I play music, it shows.

thermostat.name: Thermostat
thermostat.hover_unknown: The thermostat's not talking right now.
lines: It's {temp}°F in here. Heat's {heat}.
That's the real reading from my thermostat.

blind_living.name: Living room blind
blind_living.hover_open: The blind's all the way up.
blind_living.hover_closed: The blind's all the way down.
lines: It's my real blind in the living room.
It rolls up and down by itself.

blind_dining.name: Dining room blind
blind_dining.hover_open: The blind's all the way up.
blind_dining.hover_closed: The blind's all the way down.
lines: It's my real blind in the dining room.
It rolls up and down by itself.

empty: That's just the room. Try the doors?
Look around! Press LOOK if you're lost.
idle: The doors go places. Just so you know.
Still here? Make yourself at home.
lines.allSeen: You've seen the whole room. Thanks for visiting!
lines.lookPrompt: What do you want to look at?
